_about: DES1 (2026-11-08): Claude's hand-written proposal per map, read by tools/des1/map_signatures_2026_11_08.py. Suggestions only, nothing applied. signatures: the 2-3 (Map 10+: 1-2) skills the map is about; proposedNew: signatures + minor one-offs that stay; minor: new skills kept as one-offs (do not count); moveLater / moveEarlier: where a new skill would read as a signature instead; basics: missing basics and a bench card (out of play today, canonical/cards.json) or an edit that fills them. Bench cards are named only where they fit the map's animals.
topFlags: **One card per new skill is the norm.** 17 of 21 main maps have no new skill on 2+ of their cards, so no map has a strategy the player can see yet. The fix is mostly adding 1-2 carriers per signature, not new skills.

**Ranged is missing on Maps 0-10:** no main map before Eyrie Heights (Map 11) has a single shooter on its list. Nine out-of-play shooters (Arrow, Spark, Bola) fit those maps by animal, plus the new Reach spear card (the bench is in the JSON).
**The Tutorial shows 15 skills,** Dynamite, Landslide, Spiteful and Venomous among them: they belong to later maps.
**Side maps pre-teach main skills:** Rage, Web, Bulldoze, Herbalist, Ambush, Mighty appear on a side map before the main map that should own them.

mtut.minor: Pounce (Golden Eagle Diver) as a preview.
mtut.moveLater: Dynamite and Landslide (Map 11 Eyrie Heights, with Avalanche); Spiteful / Counterattack (Thornwood Palisade: Map 1 Thistlewood, with Thorns); Venomous (Caustic Scorpion: Map 4); Swarm (Map 0); Regeneration, Bounty.
mtut.basics: Guardian ✗: a Guardian unit in T-3..T-5 (the Terrier Pup) so the three basics are all taught.

m1.theme: Scouts and stragglers past the walls: bees and ants.
m1.note: Swarm becomes new here once the Tutorial stops showing it (Bee Warden). Map 0 is UI21's Swarm map already.
m1.basics: Ranged ✗: Acorn-pelter Squirrel (common 2/6, Arrow). Quick ½: Cottontail only; fine for Map 0.

mf.theme: Hedgerows and burrows: small busy things that gather and prick.
mf.minor: Inspiring (Cricket Drummer, the owner's pick), Thanatosis (Slow-worm: the owner's own one-off example), Pickpocket (Field Mouse).
mf.moveLater: True Sight (Owl Sentinel) to Map 6, as Invisible's answer; Devour (Hollow-belly Rat) to Map 7 or 12; Lumberjack (Badger Lumberjack) and Timbered (Woodcock Lookout) to Map 13 Redwood Deep with Milling; Crepuscular (Woodcock) to Map 7. Injured is a drawback: no count.
mf.basics: Ranged ✗: Quill-flinger Porcupine (uncommon 2/10, Arrow + Thorns) fills ranged and gives Thorns its second carrier.

mb.theme: Rock pools and shells: the tide and the things that hide in shells.
mb.minor: Pierce (Oystercatcher: the Armor answer, keep beside it).
mb.moveLater: Sonar (Dolphin Outrider) to Map 8 Caves & Alcoves, where sound is the theme.
mb.note: Tide is new on the Tutorial today (Silver Minnow, Level 1); Pebble Beach is its UI21 map and has 6 carriers.
mb.basics: Ranged ✗: Shell-drop Gull (common 1/7, Flying + Arrow). Quick ✗: Fleetfoot'd (otter, Tide + Quick).

mc.theme: Every ledge belongs to a bird: strikes from above, and the spear that answers them.
mc.moveLater: Mountain Climber (Red-billed Chough) to Map 11 Eyrie Heights; Cleave (Tomcat) to Map 16 Taiga (3 Cleave carriers there); Shell + Shield (Conch Crawler) to Smugglers' Grotto or minor; Bleed (Razorbill) to Map 10 with Gash, or minor.
mc.note: **The owner's Reach idea fits here** (ENG37): a wooden-spear animal with Reach. Reach can't be dodged by Flying, so on a map with 10 flyers it is the player's answer: a lesson, not just a card. Reach reads '?' on starters until Map 1 (Meerkat Wayfarer); this map makes it a strategy. Add a Dive carrier too: a gannet (Gannet Nestweaver) plunge-dives.
mc.basics: Ranged ✗: the Reach spear card fills it. Guardian ½ (Fiddler Crab Swarm): fine.

m2.theme: A flooded lowland: shields that hold, poison that waits, algae that spreads.
m2.note: Venomous has 3 carriers here but is new on the Tutorial (Caustic Scorpion). Bloom needs a second carrier (Pond Algae only).
m2.basics: Ranged ✗: Electric Catfish (rare 2/8, Spark). Quick ✗: give the Water Shrew Quick, or Fleetfoot'd if not used on Map 2.

mw.theme: A living swamp: logs that open their eyes, hunters that finish the poisoned.
mw.minor: Repair (Cypress Root Lurker); Cower (Box Turtle, half drawback).
mw.moveEarlier: Ambush from The Sunken Grove / Map 17 to here: the Crocodile Ambusher and Swamp Alligator are 'logs that open their eyes'. Cull (Hunter: Poisoned) needs a second carrier.
mw.basics: Ranged ✗: Reed-dart Bittern (uncommon 2/5, Arrow + Stealth). Quick ½ (Anhinga Pounce): fine.

m8.theme: A blacker wetland: things you can't see, and the doctor who keeps you alive.
m8.minor: Daunt (Booming Bittern's second skill), Immunity (Venomlord Serpent), Weaken (Lamprey).
m8.moveLater: Predator (Marsh Harrier) to Map 14 Savanna, with Prey; Evasive (Camouflage Frog) to Map 17, where 5 cards have it; Tally (Raven Scout): swap for True Sight (as SKILLREC1 proposed); Sequestration: minor or later.
m8.basics: Ranged ✗: Venom Spit on the Poison Dart Croaker instead of Sequestration (a spitting frog). Quick ✗: Quick on the Adder Ambusher.

mp.moveLater: Bulldoze (Victoria Regia) to Map 15 Long Grass, where the Bison Bulldozer owns it.
mp.basics: Ranged ✗ / Quick ✗: Mallard Marauder (rare 2/5, Flying + Pounce) for the ducks; Dam-Keeper Beaver (Rampart) gives Rampart its second carrier.

mu.theme: The mushroom hollow: rot, and things that multiply.
mu.minor: Stealth (Owl Nightwatch: a night reveal), Meld (Leafcutter Gardener).
mu.note: Read Meiosis (Planarian) and On Death spawn (Fungal Colossus) as part of the 'multiply' signature beside Brood, or demote them to minor.
mu.moveLater: Deadly Poison (Cane Toad) to Map 18 or The Pale Desert (3 Venomous there); Wither (Corpse-flower Beetle): fold into Decay or minor.
mu.basics: Ranged ✗: Puffball Bombardier (uncommon 1/5, Arrow + Venomous + Bloom: a puffball for a mushroom map). Quick ✗: a hunting spider with Pounce.

mg.theme: The smugglers' sea cave: webs in the dark.
mg.basics: Ranged ✗: Smuggler Slingrat (uncommon 1/5, Arrow + Stealth). Quick ✗: fine for a side map.

m4.theme: Sound carries further than light: echoes against glow.
m4.minor: Keen Sense (Quarry Mole; near Sonar), Bedrock (Quarry Mole), On Ready damage (Echo Screecher). Purblind is a drawback; Web came from Smugglers' Grotto.
m4.moveEarlier: Sonar from Map 2 (Dolphin Outrider) to here; the Echo Screecher bat is its natural second carrier.
m4.basics: Ranged ✗: Bolas Spider (uncommon 2/8, Bola). Guardian ½ (Stalactite Pill Bug), Quick ½ (Giant Cave Huntsman): fine.

mz.theme: Roots that listen: they sting whoever touches them.
mz.minor: Rocket (Bombardier Beetle, also the side map's shooter). Slow is a drawback.
mz.moveLater: Rage (Ant Warrior) to Map 13 Redwood Deep, its main home.

mk.theme: Salt water in the swamp: mudskippers and brackish shores.
mk.minor: Taunt (Proboscis Monkey: a basic), Relict (Horseshoe Crab, a living fossil one-off).
mk.note: Both signatures need a second carrier: Skitter on the Sunbittern Strider or Mangrove Monitor; Salt on a crab.
mk.basics: Ranged ✗: Trident Caiman (uncommon 4/11, Reach + Pierce). Quick ✗: Pounce on the Mangrove Kingfisher.

m7.theme: The open sea: tentacles that strike two ways and leave wounds.
m7.minor: Charge (Electric Ray), Nova (Supernova Jelly: a forecast one-off).
m7.note: Already the cleanest map: both signatures sit on the Colossal Squid and the Kraken Spawnling.
m7.basics: Ranged ✗: Snapgun Shrimp (common 1/7, Spark: a pistol shrimp). Quick ½ (Great Barracuda): fine.

m10.theme: Alpine cliffs: climbers and the rockfall they start.
m10.moveEarlier: Mountain Climber becomes new here once it leaves Map 3 (2 carriers here already); Landslide joins from the Tutorial as a minor.
m10.moveLater: Frostbite (Mountain Hare) to Map 17 Tundra (2 carriers there).
m10.basics: Ranged ½: Stonecracker Vulture (uncommon 2/9, Flying + Arrow).

mj.theme: A sunken ferry in a fast current: octopus country.

mh.theme: A maze: walls to break and corners to stab around.
mh.moveLater: Scavenge (Carrion Crow) to Map 20 beside Carrion.
mh.note: Siege needs a second carrier (Quill-Thorn Boar). The Mouse Sapper is the juke's teacher (feelings.md).
mh.basics: Ranged ✗: Fox Sharpshot (common 4/11, Snipe; a fox beside the Cunning Vixen). Quick ✗: Quick on the Hedge Weasel.

mq.theme: A slow clover meadow: no new skill, and that is fine.
mq.basics: Ranged ✗: optional; a side map may skip it.

mr.theme: Bears, stags and boars under red shade.
mr.moveEarlier: Rage from The Mycelium Deep to here (Berserker Boar). Lumberjack / Timbered from Map 1 would sit here as minors.
mr.note: Berserk (Tasmanian Devil) overlaps Rage and is off-theme here: fold into Rage or move the Devil.
mr.basics: Ranged ✗: Muntjac Barker (uncommon 2/11, Sentry; a deer). Quick ✗: Firetail Trickster (rare 1/11, Pounce; a fox).

ms.theme: A drowned forest: the herbalist's grove.
ms.note: If Ambush moves to Map 5, this side map teaches only Herbalist (the limit).

m5.theme: Open grassland: the hunt. Predators and the prey that dodge them.
m5.minor: Twin Shot (Spitting Cobra, also the ranged basic), Drunk (Marula Elephant: a fun one-off), Executioner (Grave-Grin Hyena).
m5.moveEarlier: Predator from Map 6 to here: Prey means nothing without it.
m5.note: Carnage (Dust Hyena) and Night-blind (Hoopoe, a drawback): minor, no count.
m5.basics: Guardian ½, Ranged ½: fine with the Cobra; Quick ✓.

ml.theme: Farm roads: fast runners and the stampede.
ml.minor: Converge (Border Collie herding: a felt one-off), Weapon Master (Armory, the militia), Bulldoze (Bison Bulldozer).
ml.note: Onslaught (second skill on the Bison) and Foe's Scarcity (Stoat): minor. Herbalist came from The Sunken Grove.
ml.basics: Ranged ½ (Talon Archer): Otter Guard (uncommon 3/5, Arrow) as village militia.

mv.theme: The oldest nests, in the storm.

mt.theme: The first wolf packs among the pines.
mt.minor: Almanac (Cone-cutter Squirrel), Moonborn (Lunar Howler), Riled (Boreal Elk).
mt.moveEarlier: Cleave from Map 3 (Tomcat) to here, where 3 cards carry it. Pack Leader wants a second carrier (Alpha Howler).
mt.basics: Ranged ✗: Pinecone Crossbill (common 1/9, Flying + Arrow). Quick ✗: Pine Marten (rare 1/14, Pounce).

mn.theme: Shiny walls and the miners they draw.

m6.theme: Frozen ground: frost that hardens you, and the hit that shatters the frozen.
m6.minor: Hibernate (Polar Bear), Lone Wolf (a one-off against the packs), Ice Arrow (the ranged basic).
m6.moveEarlier: Frostbite from Map 11 to here (2 carriers). Shatter needs a Freeze source beside it: keep the Walrus's Freeze as part of the pair.
m6.moveLater: Venom Spit (Spitting Spider) to Map 6 Sable Swampmire or The Pale Desert. Ambush (Polar Bear) stays, no longer new if Map 5 takes it. Frost (field): minor.
m6.basics: Guardian ✗: Guardian on the Harbor Seal or Beluga. Quick ✗: Quick on the Frost Hare Sprinter, or Yeti Snarer (rare 3/14, Lasso + Pounce).

md.theme: Glass sand: traps under the dunes, and hides that don't burn.
md.minor: Haste (Roadrunner Courier, a quick basic), Tornado (Dust-devil Kestrel, a big one-off).
md.moveLater: Darksight (Meerkat Burrower): minor, or to Map 8 with the dark.
md.basics: Ranged ½: Sand-flinger Antlion (common 2/7, Arrow; beside the Antlion Pit).

my.theme: The rainforest roof: vines and monkeys.
my.basics: Ranged ½: Howler Monkey (Bananarang) or Bramblewood Macaque (Banana).

m3.theme: Scorched high ground: heat that feeds the fire-born.
m3.minor: Spitfire (Fire Salamander, ranged), Scare (Yeti: a one-off).
m3.note: Recoil, Scar and Mighty: minor, no count (Mighty came from The Canopy).
m3.basics: Guardian ✗: Guardian on the Granite Ox Golem. Quick ✗: Quick on the Talus Pika.

m11.theme: The broken crown: the dead keep the fire company, and the carrion birds circle.
m11.minor: Requiem (Cinder Skeleton, beside Undead), Remember (Ashbone Ghoul).
m11.moveEarlier: Scavenge from Map 12 (Carrion Crow) to here, beside Carrion.
m11.note: Fire Arrow (2 carriers) counts as a ranged basic, not a signature.

me.theme: Inside the crater: no new skill.
me.basics: Guardian ✗ and Quick ✗: optional for a side map.

mx.theme: Where the fire is born: a forecast fireball.
mx.basics: Guardian ✗: optional for a side map.
